sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule orange-brown to brown, frons and genae paler; head surface with pale yellow punctures at the setal bases; anteclypeus yellowish white, labrum yellow; antennae pale yellow, the basal segments darker, brownish on both sides. Pronotum pale orange, darker than the postclypeus, with a pale median longitudinal stripe. Abdominal tergites and legs pale orange-brown; tibiae with a darker narrow band near the proximal end. Posterior margin of head capsule arcuate and evenly rounded; setae numerous above and behind the compound eyes, none extending beyond the eye bulge; vertex slightly concave or not concave in the fontanelle area; fontanelle a small round pore, situated behind the line joining the midpoints of the compound eyes; central spot oval, smaller than the ocelli; coronal suture indistinct or absent; frons smooth, sloping towards the postclypeus. Compound eyes and ocelli oval, ocelli distinctly separated from the compound eyes, the gap less than half the smallest diameter of an ocellus; postclypeus not a regular semicircle, median suture distinct; labrum length less than width; antennae 15/16-segmented, segment 3 shortest, segments 1, 2 and 4 subequal. Pronotum with numerous setae, anterior margin almost straight, posterior margin slightly concave; meso- and metanota without a median line, posterior margin with a deep, blunt angular notch. Wings extending beyond the abdomen, about twice the body length.
